_comment: THE file to edit when FLC changes. Everything the pages show about versions, downloads, donations, reports and builds comes from here (texts live in i18n/<lang>.json). Leave a url empty and the page shows an honest 'not available yet' state instead of a link. See README.md, section 'Updating'.

site.name: Forever Leveling Companion
site._base_url: The public address (no trailing slash): https://flc.quest, registered by the owner at Porkbun on 2026-11-04. It can also hold a folder (e.g. https://firebrand-dev.github.io/ForeverLevelingCompanion). The build writes dist/CNAME for a custom domain.

status._comment: stage: 'released' (a public version exists) or 'development'. build: the game client build the current download was tested with (our development server, never the official realms). suites / lua_errors: from the addon's docs/release/LAUNCH_REPORT_2026-11-04.md.

download._comment: Public download. enabled: true only for a real GitHub Release asset the owner approved. tools/sync_release.py --from-github fills version/file/size/sha256/date and checks SHA256SUMS.txt. 0.8.1.3 synced 2026-11-10: SHA-256 09cbe0b4... equals the zip QA verified (and the release's SHA256SUMS.txt).

builds._comment: Game client builds and what was checked on each, newest first. status: tested | untested. note: an i18n key under download.build_note_*. Every run was on our development server.

donations._comment: Put the owner's OWN page addresses here once the accounts exist and are tested (docs/DONATIONS.md). Never the platform's home page. Empty url: the card says 'coming soon'. Donations unlock nothing.

campaign._comment: Only real, verifiable numbers. enabled false hides the whole block.
